title: Sesame becomes the new Main Sponsor of Levante UD
article_text:
The leading comprehensive platform in talent and human resources management supports the club for the entire season.

Levante UD and Sesame, the leading comprehensive platform for talent and human resources management, have reached a sponsorship agreement through which the Valencian technology company becomes the Main Sponsor of the club starting from the 2026/27 season.

As the main sponsor of the men's first team, Sesame will feature on the front of the official game jersey as we already saw a few days ago with the launch of the first and second kits, on training gear, and on other physical and digital assets of the club. The agreement also includes a comprehensive program of activations, VIP experiences, corporate events, and content initiatives that will bring the brand closer to fans and the business community.

For Sesame, this sponsorship represents a key step in its brand positioning and visibility, associating itself with one of the historic clubs of Spanish football and a benchmark in Valencian sports. Additionally, this agreement reflects a growing trend in which high-growth technology companies seek to connect their brands with spaces capable of generating community, belonging, and shared emotions. For the company, football represents an environment where values such as teamwork, perseverance, and talent development are experienced every day.

“This alliance with Levante UD makes perfect sense for us. Football and scale-ups like Sesame have much more in common than it seems. Both of us thrive on building teams, developing talent, making quick decisions, and competing every day to improve. At Sesame, we believe that this way of understanding growth deserves to go beyond offices and connect with millions of people,” stated Albert Soriano, CEO of Sesame.

The head of Sesame also emphasized the local nature of the collaboration. “We are especially excited that this agreement is with a club from our homeland. We are a tech company born in Valencia that now works with companies all over the world, and we are very proud of our origins as well as being able to support Levante UD,” added Soriano.

For Levante UD, it is a great satisfaction to be associated with and display on their chest the brand of a Valencian technology company that is a leader in the field of human resources. “The arrival of Sesame as the main sponsor reinforces our commitment to innovation, professionalism, and continuing to grow hand in hand with companies that are transforming their sectors from Valencia to the world,” stated Pablo Sánchez, president of Levante UD.

Following the announcement of this agreement, Sesame and Levante UD are opening a new phase of collaboration in which various joint actions are planned, as well as the promotion of projects that go beyond sports sponsorship, bringing innovation, technology, sports, and the values of talent closer to Levante fans and society as a whole.

Sesame is human resources software focused on redefining the employee experience. It allows the digitalization of the most routine human resources processes so that managers and HR professionals can focus on talent, professional development, and the well-being of their teams, thereby growing their business and building a successful corporate culture. Currently, they have more than 20,000 clients in over 30 countries across Europe and Latin America.

title: kwiff confirms 2026 WDF World Darts Championship sponsorship
article_text:
The darts championship runs until early December.

kwiff, the super-charged sports betting service, is returning to Lakeside as a sponsor of the 2026 WDF World Darts Championship.

Kicking off today and running until December 6, the tournament is expected to welcome between 15,000 and 20,000 spectators, with kwiff delivering a comprehensive sponsorship activation spanning venue branding, fan engagement, broadcast exposure and digital content.

The popular kwiff Zone will return to Lakeside, giving fans aged 25 and over the opportunity to showcase their skills in a daily 9 Dart Challenge, with prizes supplied by Target Darts. kwiff’s branding will also feature on the iconic 180 signs held aloft by fans throughout the tournament.

Away from Lakeside, kwiff has secured live-streaming and social media clipping rights, enabling the brand to share tournament action and highlights across its digital channels. Additional brand exposure is planned across the WDF’s YouTube content.

To complement the sponsorship, kwiff has also joined forces with its existing football partners, Millwall FC and Blackburn Rovers FC, to produce a series of darts-themed videos. Players from both clubs have taken part in the kwiff 9 Darts Challenge and kwiff Bullseye Challenge, with content set to be released throughout the tournament.

Darts continues to resonate strongly with kwiff’s customers, ranking as the third most popular sport on the platform behind football and horse racing.

“Lakeside holds a special place in the world of darts, and we cannot wait to return for another edition of the WDF World Darts Championship,” said Jack Milner, sponsorship and partnerships manager at kwiff.

“Darts is a sport that really resonates with our customers, and this year we’re bringing together our on-site activation, digital content and existing football partnerships to extend the reach of our sponsorship well beyond the venue. Bring on a fantastic ten days of darts!”

This content has been published as part of a premium editorial package.

title: Al Nahda Centre partners with Dubai Capitals for ILT20 Season 5, announces UAE’s 55th National Day celebration
article_text:
Al Nahda Centre has been named an associate partner of Dubai Capitals for Season 5 of the DP World International League T20 (ILT20). The partnership was announced at a press conference at Anantara Downtown Dubai Hotel. The event opened with an introductory speech by Noor, an AI-powered robot, highlighting the centre’s focus on innovation and smart customer experiences.

The agreement was signed by Nabeel Ahmed Mohammed, CEO, and Rashid Aslam, director, on behalf of Al Nahda Centre. Sujoy Ganguly, chief commercial officer at GMR Sports, and Ajith Gopinathan Nair, vice president – corporate finance and strategy at GMR Group, signed on behalf of Dubai Capitals. UAE national team cricketer Haider Ali, Al Nahda Centre operations director Faizal Bin Muhammed and Dubai Capitals AGM – sports operations Siva Kumar also attended.

The partnership will include joint branding, fan engagement activities and customer contests offering opportunities to win tickets to Dubai Capitals’ home matches. Al Nahda Centre will also handle end-to-end visa processing for the team’s players and support staff.

"Behind every document is a person moving forward," said Aslam. "Dubai Capitals bring diverse communities together on the pitch. We serve that exact diversity every single day, and this partnership allows even more residents to discover how we support them."

Al Nahda Centre will celebrate the UAE’s 55th National Day on December 1, 2026, under the theme “Many Nationalities. United Under One Flag.” The event will feature an official flag-hoisting ceremony, traditional Emirati performances and multicultural programmes.

title: Softball Australia Signs WorldHotels as Official Partner in Three-Year Agreement
article_text:
Softball Australia has signed global hospitality network WorldHotels as an Official Partner under a three-year commercial agreement spanning high-performance national pathways and major international event delivery.

The partnership places the WorldHotels logo across the playing helmets of the Australian women’s national softball team, the Aussie Spirit, throughout the three-year term, including at the upcoming World Baseball Softball Confederation (WBSC) Women’s Softball World Cup Finals 2027 in Redcliffe, Queensland.

Operating a portfolio of 18 brands and more than 4,000 hotels across over 100 countries, WorldHotels joins an expanding commercial roster for the national governing body alongside inaugural Finals sponsor A.G. Coombs, apparel partner S-Trend, and training supplier PTP.

Commenting on the partnership, Softball Australia chief executive officer, Sarah Loh, said: “I’m delighted to welcome WorldHotels to the Softball Australia family.”

“To have a globally-reconised brand on board as an Official Partner for the next three years, including the WBSC Women’s Softball World Cup Finals, is exciting for the growth of softball in Australia and a strong endorsement of where our sport is heading.

“As we build to hosting the world’s best softball nations in Redcliffe, Queensland, in April 2027, partnerships like this play a crucial role in supporting our high-performance programs, delivering a world-class event and leaving a lasting legacy for softball in Australia,” Loh said.

WorldHotels Australasia managing director, Rod Munro, highlighted the alignment between the group’s international hotel footprint and Australian softball’s build-up toward Los Angeles 2028.

“Softball Australia is entering an exciting new era, and we are proud to be part of that journey.”

“We look forward to supporting athletes, staff and stakeholders across Australia, and helping to create a memorable experience at the WBSC Women’s Softball World Cup Finals 2027.

“The World Cup will leave a significant legacy for the sport and provides an important launchpad on the road to the LA28 Olympic Games and beyond.

“It is a privilege to support Softball Australia both nationally and international throughout this journey.

“With 18 brands, more than 4,000 hotels across over 100 countries, this partnership is a natural fit as we work together to support the growth and success of Australian softball,” Munro said.

Commercially, the multi-year term provides Softball Australia with international accommodation capacity and brand backing across a critical Olympic qualification cycle.

Staged at Kayo Stadium in Redcliffe from 5 to 11 April 2027, the eight-team WBSC Women’s Softball World Cup Finals will award a direct berth to the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games, where softball returns to the Olympic programme, creating high-value broadcast exposure and international visitor demand across south-east Queensland.

Football360 scores exclusive Australian broadcast rights to Liga Portugal Betclic
article_text:
Australian football platform Football360 has secured exclusive Australian broadcast rights with English commentary to the Liga Portugal Betclic, for the remainder of the 2026/27 season.

The agreement, brokered by global sports marketing agency SPORTFIVE, will see Football360 stream two live matches every matchweek from Portugal’s top division, giving Australians access to some of the competition’s biggest clubs and the chance to follow Socceroos Nestory Irankunda (Sporting CP) and Alessandro Circati (Benfica) in action.

The first match to be broadcast to Australian audiences on Football360 will feature Porto against Sporting CP, kicking off on Monday November 30, at 7:30am AEDT.

Benfica’s home match against Famalicao will also be broadcast on the platform the day after, with kick-off at 7.15am AEDT.

Live matches, full-match replays and mini matches will be available at no extra cost to Football360 members through the platform’s website, as part of their recently launched membership offering. If fans only want to access the streaming and no other membership benefits, they can do so via a Portugal Pass, allowing access to the Liga Portugal Betclic matches.

Football360 will select two matches from each matchweek for broadcast, favouring Sporting CP and Benfica games when possible.

“When both of these Socceroos stars moved to Liga Portugal Betclic, we couldn’t believe, as fans ourselves, that their games weren’t available to watch in Australia,” said Football360 co-founders Antony Pinshaw and David Weiner.

“So, we decided to do something about it.

“Our mission is to make football in Australia easier and more enjoyable to follow and consume for fans. Making matches featuring Irankunda and Circati accessible to Australian audiences is another important step towards achieving that.

“This is our first foray into live broadcasting, and we’re incredibly excited to bring these matches to Australian fans and showcase another major European competition.”

Damien Moston, Executive Vice President Sales & Marketing Partnerships, APAC & Managing Director, Australia, at SPORTFIVE, said of the agreement: “SPORTFIVE distributes and connects great sports content with the right audiences in global, regional and domestic markets through our extensive network worldwide.

“With two of Australia’s favourite Socceroos playing in Portugal, we are delighted that football fans in Australia will now get to watch their local heroes and enjoy the best of Liga Portugal Betclic via Football360.

“By combining SPORTFIVE’s global expertise with strong local relationships across Asia Pacific, we can open new markets for rights holders while creating relevant and engaging experiences for fans.”

title: Sports Direct Signs Major Five-Year Deal with Shamrock Rovers
article_text:
Shamrock Rovers have confirmed a major new commercial partnership with Sports Direct Ireland, which will become the club’s official front-of-shirt sponsor from the 2027 season.

The five-year agreement covers both the men’s and women’s senior teams and is one of the biggest commercial partnerships in the history of the Tallaght-based club.

The partnership goes well beyond the standard shirt sponsorship model, with the two organisations committing to a range of fan engagement initiatives, community activities and exclusive supporter experiences.

There will also be a significant retail element to the relationship with the new Shamrock Rovers kit going on sale via nine Sports Direct stores across Dublin and Kildare, giving the club a much broader high street presence.

The financial terms of the agreement have not been disclosed.

“We’re absolutely delighted to be welcoming Sports Direct as our new Front of Shirt partner’ said CEO Robbie Hedderman.

“This is one of the most significant commercial deals in the history of the club, and it reflects the ambition we have for Shamrock Rovers both on and off the pitch.”

“Sports Direct is a brand that shares our belief in the power of sport to bring people together, and it is very important to us that their name will be on the front of the shirt worn by both our Men’s and Women’s senior teams.”

“Beyond the shirt, we’re very excited to be working with Sports Direct on a number of new initiatives to support our fans and to extend the reach of our Community Foundation from Tallaght and beyond.”

The deal sees another property added to Sports Direct’s significant investment in Irish sport, as part of its wider programme of sponsorship across Gaelic games and football.

“As one of the most iconic and successful clubs in Irish football, we’re very excited to be embarking on this new chapter with Shamrock Rovers,” said Leonard Brassel, Managing Director at Sports Direct Ireland.

“Together we want to create opportunities for the fans, support the wider community and help inspire more people to get involved in sport.”

The new 2027 kit will be available in Sports Direct stores at The Square Tallaght, Henry Street, Liffey Valley, Blanchardstown, Carrickmines, Finglas, Maynooth, Naas and Newbridge.

It’ll also be available from the club store at Tallaght Stadium in December, of course, capitalising on the key Christmas retail period.

A five-year commitment from a major international retailer is another clear vote of confidence in the League of Ireland’s commercial direction and gives Shamrock Rovers a degree of financial certainty to build on.

The fact that both senior teams are in is a good thing, and the commitment to the Shamrock Rovers Community Foundation’s work is obviously a positive.

The retail side is the most interesting. Getting League of Ireland merchandise into mainstream sports goods stores alongside the merchandise of big international clubs would be a massive boost to the game’s profile and would expose the club to a whole new audience.

Competition between brands for a foothold in Irish football is obviously increasing, and this deal is another clear sign of the commercialisation of the domestic game.

Bodø/Glimt lead global football clubs with 555 per cent social media growth in 2026
article_text:
Bodø/Glimt recorded the highest percentage increase in social media followers among the world’s leading football clubs in 2026, with their combined Instagram and TikTok audience increasing by 555 per cent between 1st January and 17th November, according to data platform Football Benchmark.

The club’s following grew from approximately 136,000 to 888,000, placing them at the top of Football Benchmark’s ranking of the ten fastest-growing clubs by percentage. Their 555 per cent growth rate was more than 2.7 times that of Chicago Fire FC, the second-ranked club, which recorded an increase of 205 per cent, with Turkish side Trabzonspor registering 140 per cent growth closing in the first three clubs with the biggest digital increase. Also worth highlighting is the contrast with Como 1907, the emerging force in Italian football, which ranked fourth with 138 per cent growth – more than five times lower than Bodø/Glimt’s figure. The analysis took into account only clubs with at least 100k total followers across Instagram and TikTok.

Having competed in Norway’s second division as recently as 2017, Bodø/Glimt have transformed their sporting standing through sustained development and consistent performances on the European stage. Last season’s Uefa Champions League campaign, featuring victories over Manchester City and Atlético de Madrid before eliminating Inter, further elevated the club’s international profile.

The figures demonstrate how sporting performance and European competition exposure can accelerate international audience growth, creating opportunities to strengthen brand positioning, expand commercial reach and attract new partners.

Bodø/Glimt’s achievement also highlights the changing dynamics of football’s global attention economy, where ambitious clubs can build significant international audiences through sporting credibility and a distinctive competitive identity, challenging the traditional dominance of established football brands.

Source: Football Benchmark Social Media Analytics Platform. Combined Instagram and TikTok followers, 1 January–17 November 2026.

title: Gloucestershire County Cricket Club unveils new ‘Bristol Lions’ identity to compete in T20 Blast for 2027
article_text:
Tuesday 24 November 2026, Bristol: Gloucestershire County Cricket Club has today announced a historic expansion of its sporting brand, unveiling a dedicated T20 identity – Bristol Lions – alongside a refined visual evolution of the club’s core county crest.

The introduction of Bristol Lions as the club’s T20 team introduces a distinct, high-energy brand for both the men’s and women’s squads ahead of the 2027 season – with the Lions’ fixtures to be released tomorrow (Wednesday 25 November).

The new Bristol Lions identity, grounded in extensive audience research, market insight and commercial analysis aims to tap into an uncaptured market of sports followers across Bristol, accelerate commercial revenues, and secure long-term financial sustainability to directly reinvest back into cricket across all formats.

Crucially, the identity and 150 year heritage of Gloucestershire County Cricket Club remains completely unchanged. All County Championship and One-Day Cup matches, along with talent pathway development, will continue under the Gloucestershire banner, as will the club’s deep commitment to the annual festival at Cheltenham.

The introduction of the Bristol Lions identity represents a strategic initiative designed to establish a direct, modern connection for short-form cricket within the region, laying the foundation for long-term commercial growth and community engagement.

Neil Priscott, Chief Executive Officer at Gloucestershire County Cricket Club, said: “Gloucestershire County Cricket Club remains unchanged at our core, anchored in over 150 years of heritage. Unveiling the Bristol Lions T20 identity is a proactive, strategic step to widen our supporter base across this vibrant city. By establishing a modern connection for short-form cricket, we aim to fill stadium seats, engage younger and more diverse audiences, and build financial equity to compete at the highest domestic levels. This approach safeguards our history while driving sustainable growth for generations to come.”

Jon Lewis, Director of Cricket, said: “From a high-performance perspective, our goal is clear. We want to consistently compete as a Top 8 county across all formats. The T20 format demands intensity, energy, modern presentation, and a powerful connection with the crowd. Establishing the Bristol Lions identity gives our players a powerful platform to build on, exciting current fans while inspiring a new generation of players and supporters across the region.”

Fran Wilson, Head Coach, Women’s Cricket, said: “Bringing both the men’s and women’s teams under the Bristol Lions identity from day one is a huge statement. Women’s cricket is expanding at an unprecedented rate and we continue to work tremendously hard as a club to bring more support to the women’s game. By having an aligned, vibrant brand allows us to do just that – building a shared fanbase, equal visibility, and deeper community connection across Bristol and the wider region.”

Jenny Hall, Head of Audience Development: “Our market research highlighted a major opportunity to connect with sports fans across Bristol who haven’t previously engaged with county cricket. The Bristol Lions T20 identity allows us to step-change our ticketing, partnership, and commercial potential. We are creating an exciting, accessible brand that speaks to the heart of the city while maintaining respect for Gloucestershire’s traditional roots.”

Today’s announcement by the club is accompanied by an official launch campaign video detailing the story of Gloucestershire’s legacy and the birth of the Bristol Lion, which is available to download here.

title: GB, French, German swimming bodies launch annual competition
article_text:
The governing bodies for swimming in Great Britain, France, and Germany have teamed up to launch a new annual international competition as they seek to modernise the sport and attract new audiences.

The 3 Nations Cup is a joint venture between Aquatics GB, the French Swimming Federation, and the German Swimming Federation and will debut in Manchester on March 14, 2027, before moving to Paris on March 21.

Combine business intelligence and editorial excellence to reach engaged professionals across 36 leading media platforms.

The new annual series will feature 22 races over 90 minutes. Mixed relays sit alongside women’s and men’s 50m ‘skins’ races in butterfly, backstroke, and breaststroke. Six swimmers will start, with four advancing, and just two reaching the final round.

To add an element of engagement and interaction to the team contest, spectators will draw the swimming order for the mixed 4x200m freestyle relay.

Points will count across both legs, and the team at the top of the standings after Paris will take the 3 Nations Cup title and share the prize money.

Through the 3 Nations Cup, the three federations said they are “creating a fresh way for fans to experience elite swimming, and a new platform through which to engage audiences, broadcasters, and commercial partners.”

Drew Barrand, Aquatics GB CEO, said: “It is time for elite swimming competition to evolve. Together with our counterparts in France and Germany, we have created a series that puts the excitement of racing at its heart.

“We want fans to feel the pressure of every race. With elimination rounds, mixed relays and points carrying across two weekends, the 3 Nations Cup gives them a fast-paced team contest to get behind from the first start to the final touch.

“This is a shared venture and a shared ambition. Leading from the front means putting new ideas into action, and all three nations are bringing that commitment to the pool.”

Next month, the International Swimming League (ISL), the club-based professional series, will also be making its return.

The league's upcoming one-night relaunch event, the ISL All-Star Match, will take place at the London Aquatics Centre in Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park on December 19.

The All-Star Match will see the world's fastest swimmers compete in a team-based, two-hour, head-to-head competition.

Stakeholders in the sport are increasingly looking to maintain annual interest in swimming outside the Olympics through frequent, short-form competitions.

For British swimming, the 3 Nations Cup opens a three-part season in 2027, ahead of the Aquatics GB Swimming Championships in London in April and the World Aquatics Championships in Budapest in July.

Live coverage is planned for both legs of the 3 Nations Cup, with broadcast details to follow.

Earlier this year, the European Broadcasting Union (EBU), the continent’s association of public-service broadcasters, expanded its partnership with Aquatics GB to boost the visibility of international events in the UK.

The expanded agreement will see an increase in the range of events available free-to-air (FTA) in the UK throughout the year, including swimming, diving, artistic swimming, and open water swimming, via the Eurovision Sport streaming service, which will be embedded within the Aquatics GB website.
